# dsh-finalize
**English** | 简体中文
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that runs **one finalize pass the moment a file is delivered** — and nowhe
re else. It strips the fingerprints document libraries leave behind, recomputes the statistics that
are actually derivable, and puts everything it **will not** fabricate into a side panel instead of w
riting it into the file.

> **Design rule: fix what is provably wrong, never invent evidence.**
> Edit time, revision history,
comments and "was written by a human" claims are reported, not written. `Application` is removed ra
ther than replaced with a fake `Microsoft Office Word 16.0` string — absence is unremarkable, a lie
contradicts the rest of the package.
## Why this exists
Documents produced by `python-docx`, `python-pptx`, `openpyxl` or LibreOffice carry their own birth
certificate: a creator field naming the library, a 2013 template date, `Words=0` on a forty-page rep
ort, a leftover template thumbnail. Those are bugs, not style choices, and anyone who unzips the fil
template thumbnail. Those are bugs, not style choices, and anyone who unzips the file can see them.
The usual advice — forge the edit time, invent a revision count — makes things worse. It contradicts
the fields you cannot change (the `rsid` trail, the real save history) and collapses the moment som
eone looks. This plugin takes the honest half: normalize what is wrong, report what only a human can
ks. This plugin takes the honest half: normalize what is wrong, report what only a human can supply.
## What it does
| Format | Automatic fixes | Reported, never fixed |
| `docx` | creator and description, template date, `Application`/`AppVersion`, word/character/paragr
aph/line counts, template thumbnail | `TotalTime=0`, page count, punctuation, unresolved comments, u

naccepted revisions, hidden and white text |
| `pptx` | same core properties, slide/notes/hidden-sli
de counts, word counts | no speaker notes, cropped images still in `ppt/media`, hidden slides and sh

apes, comments, speaker notes |
| `xlsx` | core properties, `TitlesOfParts` aligned to sheet names |
zero formulas, pivot cache retaining deleted rows, external links, hidden sheets, rows and columns,

comments |
| `odt` `ods` `odp` | `meta:generator`, creator, dates, `meta:document-statistic`, thumb
nail and its manifest entry | `meta:editing-duration=PT0S`, single save cycle, annotations, hidden t

ext and sheets |
| `pdf` | **nothing — read-only by design** | Producer/Creator/XMP, incremental upd
ates, missing bookmarks, signatures, punctuation in extractable text |
Several files in one delivery are processed independently. Several deliveries in one session merge i
nto a single report for 30 minutes instead of overwriting each other.
## Text checks
When a document is delivered, its paragraphs are also checked for punctuation that does not match th
eir language. The language is detected per paragraph from script counts (Han / Kana / Hangul / Latin
), and Latin paragraphs are separated into English, French and German by diacritics and stop words.
| Language | Expected | Flagged example |

| Chinese | `，。！？；：、（）“”` | `这是测试,包含逗号` |
| Japanese | `、。「」『』` | `テスト，です` |
| Korean | ASCII `, . ?

!` | `테스트，입니다` |
| English / French / German | ASCII, plus each language's own quotes (`« »`, `„ “`
) | `sentence，with` |
Also flagged: spaces before punctuation, three or more repeated marks, and unbalanced `“ ”` / `「 」`
gged: spaces before punctuation, three or more repeated marks, and unbalanced `“ ”` / `「 」` / `『 』`.
Findings are **reported, never rewritten** — a blind character swap damages code, URLs, formulas and
citations far more often than it helps. In the panel every finding group can be expanded into its i
ndividual occurrences (up to 50, each with the original snippet and the suggested replacement). URLs
, e-mail addresses, paths, decimals and list numbers (`1.`, `3.2`) are skipped entirely; spreadsheet
cells are only checked when longer than eight characters.
PDF text is decoded from the text layer: Flate content streams, `Tj`/`TJ` operators and per-font `To
Unicode` maps, including Identity-H CID fonts, so Word and LibreOffice exports are covered. Scanned
pages, fonts without a `ToUnicode` map and text drawn as outlines cannot be read — those files are r
eported as *not checked* rather than guessed at.
**Only your own text is judged.** When the delivered document reuses paragraphs from a file the user
supplied, those paragraphs are treated as the template: they are never listed as problems, and thei
r punctuation style becomes the accepted style for new text — a template that writes `一:` makes the
assistant's `二:` correct, not an error. Text the user edited themselves falls into the same bucket:
noted, never changed.

## Review state
A document carries more than its visible pages. Before delivery the plugin reports what still travel
es more than its visible pages. Before delivery the plugin reports what still travels with the file:
| Finding | Detail |

| Unresolved comments | count, authors, date and text of each comment (docx, pptx, xlsx, odf) |
| Un

accepted revisions | count, authors, and the text that was deleted (docx) |
| Hidden content | hidde
n text, white text, hidden slides and shapes, speaker notes, hidden sheets, rows and columns |

## Compatibility
Built to sit beside other plugins without changing their behaviour.
- **No tool, no prompt section.** Nothing is added to the model's tool list or system prompt, so tok

en accounting and tool selection are untouched.
- **One passive listener.** `tools/pre-execute` runs
only for the configured delivery tools, always returns `next()`, and swallows its own failures, so

it can neither block nor rewrite another tool's call.
- **No transport coupling.** It hooks the deli

very tool, not a transport, so QQ, Web and CLI transports keep working.
- **Namespaced surface.** Ro
utes are `/api/finalize.report` and `/api/finalize.scan`; the slot id is `dsh-finalize`. Neither col

lides with the shipped `deliverables`, `changes.*` or `presented` routes.
- **Opt-in debug only.** N
othing is written outside the delivered files unless `DSH_FINALIZE_DEBUG=1`.
